title: UPF -> SMF PFCP ASSOCIATION not working
body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.7.2

### Steps to reproduce

Hey,
we observed an issue with the upf when using a smf ip configured in upf and not a list of upfs configured in smf. 
When the upf contacts the (running) smf to associate it logs a successfull association
```
03/21 15:44:28.031: [pfcp] INFO: pfcp_server() [0.0.0.0]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/path.c:30)
03/21 15:44:28.031: [pfcp] INFO: ogs_pfcp_connect() [10.43.33.242]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/path.c:61)
03/21 15:44:28.031: [gtp] INFO: gtp_server() [0.0.0.0]:2152 (../lib/gtp/path.c:30)
03/21 15:44:28.032: [app] INFO: UPF initialize...done (../src/upf/app.c:31)
03/21 15:44:28.032: [upf] INFO: PFCP associated [10.43.33.242]:8805 (../src/upf/pfcp-sm.c:184)
03/21 15:44:37.854: [upf] INFO: [Added] Number of UPF-Sessions is now 1 (../src/upf/context.c:207)
03/21 15:44:37.854: [gtp] INFO: gtp_connect() [0.0.0.0]:2152 (../lib/gtp/path.c:60)
03/21 15:44:37.854: [upf] INFO: UE F-SEID[UP:0x634 CP:0x51a] APN[internet] PDN-Type[1] IPv4[10.48.0.2] IPv6[] (../src/upf/context.c:493)
03/21 15:44:37.854: [upf] INFO: UE F-SEID[UP:0x634 CP:0x51a] APN[internet] PDN-Type[1] IPv4[10.48.0.2] IPv6[] (../src/upf/context.c:493)
03/21 15:44:37.862: [gtp] INFO: gtp_connect() [172.27.99.185]:2152 (../lib/gtp/path.c:60)
03/21 15:44:42.699: [pfcp] INFO: ogs_pfcp_connect() [10.42.128.38]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/path.c:61)
```

However when UEs (re-)connect we sometimes (we were not able to reproduce this reliable) see the following error messages:
```
03/21 15:44:42.699: [upf] WARNING: cannot handle PFCP message type[52] (../src/upf/pfcp-sm.c:150)
03/21 15:44:44.603: [upf] WARNING: cannot handle PFCP message type[54] (../src/upf/pfcp-sm.c:150)
03/21 15:44:45.200: [pfcp] WARNING: [5] REMOTE Request Duplicated. Discard! for step 1 type 52 peer [10.42.128.38]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:404)
03/21 15:44:47.105: [pfcp] WARNING: [6] REMOTE Request Duplicated. Discard! for step 1 type 54 peer [10.42.128.38]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:404)
03/21 15:44:47.701: [pfcp] WARNING: [5] REMOTE Request Duplicated. Discard! for step 1 type 52 peer [10.42.128.38]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:404)
03/21 15:44:49.605: [pfcp] WARNING: [6] REMOTE Request Duplicated. Discard! for step 1 type 54 peer [10.42.128.38]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:404)
03/21 15:44:52.072: [upf] WARNING: cannot handle PFCP message type[50] (../src/upf/pfcp-sm.c:150)
03/21 15:44:54.572: [pfcp] WARNING: [8] REMOTE Request Duplicated. Discard! for step 1 type 50 peer [10.42.128.38]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:404)
03/21 15:44:57.074: [pfcp] WARNING: [8] REMOTE Request Duplicated. Discard! for step 1 type 50 peer [10.42.128.38]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:404)
03/21 15:45:00.347: [upf] WARNING: cannot handle PFCP message type[50] (../src/upf/pfcp-sm.c:150)
```

Which after looking through the code indicates to me that the upf is in `upf_pfcp_state_will_associate` state even tho it should already be associated? 

Here are the corresponding smf logs:
```
03/21 15:44:28.031: [pfcp] INFO: ogs_pfcp_connect() [10.42.128.59]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/path.c:61)

...

...

...

03/21 15:44:52.106: [smf] ERROR: Session has already been removed [54] (../src/smf/pfcp-path.c:237)
03/21 15:44:54.837: [smf] ERROR: Unknown event [OGS_EVENT_NAME_SBI_SERVER] (../src/smf/gsm-sm.c:759)
03/21 15:44:55.601: [sbi] INFO: RST_STREAM received: stream_id=11 (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:1246)
03/21 15:44:55.601: [sbi] ERROR: on_stream_close_callback() failed (5:STREAM_CLOSED) (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:1278)
03/21 15:44:59.574: [pfcp] WARNING: [8] LOCAL  No Reponse. Give up! for step 1 type 50 peer [10.42.128.59]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:619)
03/21 15:44:59.574: [smf] WARNING: No PFCP session establishment response (../src/smf/pfcp-path.c:245)
```

EDIT: Here is a config snippet of the upf pfcp section:
```
upf:
    pfcp:
      server:
        - address: 0.0.0.0
          port: 8805
      client:
        smf:
          - address: open5gs-smf-pfcp # resolves to smf ip
```  


### Logs

```shell

```

### Expected behaviour

UPF -> SMF Association is valid and UE Sessions can be set up

### Observed Behaviour

UPF doesnt work. 
After a manual restart of  UPF everything works (until next reboot of everything)

### eNodeB/gNodeB

_No response_

### UE Models and versions

UERANSIM / Real devices
